title: Changing the rules

statement.en: The governance authority shall adopt a change to the rulebook only after consulting the participants and by the decision rule set in the governance model, shall publish each version with a change log, and shall give notice of at least the period set at Level 1 before a change enters into force. Local extensions may strengthen a core rule but shall not weaken it.

control: For each version: a consultation record, a decision record, a published change log and a notice date exist

expressions.note: Rulebook version identifier carried in the data space self-description; rule identifiers stable across versions.

source: DS4Skills rulebook v0.4 GOV-01 to GOV-03
